idea-plugin.name: LocaleBreeze
idea-plugin.description:
LocaleBreeze turns i18next translation keys into IDE-aware symbols. It infers the namespace and key scope from your code, understands which dictionary entry each key refers to, and connects translation calls with their JSON definitions—without running a full TypeScript type checker.

  • Infer key context: understands useTranslation, i18next.t, namespaces, keyPrefix, and configurable scoped or full-key translation functions.
  • Navigate in both directions: go from a translation call to its JSON entry, or from a dictionary key to a popup containing every indexed usage.
  • Find and count usages: see how many references a key has and open each source location with its file, line number, and code preview.
  • Catch translation problems: highlights missing keys, invalid interpolation arguments, ignored-scope references, and optionally unused dictionary keys and scopes.
  • Complete the right key: suggests full, relative, and partial keys using the namespace and translator scope inferred at the cursor.
  • Understand values at a glance: hover over a key to preview its default-locale translation or inspect the children of a scope.
  • Monitor project health: view dictionary and key totals, unused-key counts, configuration issues, and an on-demand report for invalid usages.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.3.0

  • New tool window that shows status and can generate project health report.
  • Now supporting multiple namespaces.
  • Added missing-key, missing interpolation argument diagnostics.
  • Added workspace metrics and an on-demand project health report to the tool window.
  • Added automatic configuration discovery, starter configuration creation, and support for external dictionary directories.
